title: PCI-DSS: Third-Party Penetration Test
description:
Mandatory third-party penetration test of the Nexora payments infrastructure. Required for PCI-DSS Level 1 certification.

Vendor: SecureForge Ltd (contracted Nov 12 per standup_04 notes).
Schedule: November 25 - December 6, 2024.
Scope: Payments microservice, VPC subnet (NEX-218), API endpoints, webhook handling (NEX-231 and related PR #47).

Blocker for NEX-204 Payments go-live. This 3-4 week lead time is the primary reason the December 15 date was missed — see email_02 and email_03 for the full timeline discussion.

Kenji will provide daily status updates to Raj Patel during the test window (per sprint_review_01 action items).
